facts.text: I provided sample data in JSON format that includes fields like _id, specialtyAreas, experience, status, npi, staffCostId, specializationId, aboutDoctor, userId, calendarId, createdAt, updatedAt, and __v.
The sample data includes an experience array with the strings "test hdjkhj dsadas ", "test2jjjj", "jhbhghj", "kkkkkk", and "Cambridge_AQA".

The sample data includes aboutDoctor value "Doctor cookie".

The sample data includes createdAt as a $date with $numberLong "1634556408189".
The sample data includes updatedAt as a $date with $numberLong "1676968769579".
The sample data includes workHours entries with queue and appointments booleans and startTime/endTime numeric values.
